# Mimris

Mimris is an approach and product ecosystem for turning domain knowledge into explicit models that people, software, and AI can understand and use.

Core proposition: Model the world. Work with it.

## Core concepts

- Active Knowledge Modelling is the practice of creating connected, evolvable models that remain usable as context for exploration, decisions, applications, AI, and work.
- A Universe is a bounded, coherent representation of a domain or world that humans and AI can work within.
- Mimris Modelling is the specialist environment for creating, structuring, visualizing, inspecting, and evolving models of complex domains.
- Mimris AI Workspace is the AI-enabled environment where structured models become context for documents, processes, tasks, decisions, and deliverables.

## Product boundary

- Capabilities that primarily create or manipulate model structure belong in Mimris Modelling.
- Capabilities that primarily help a person or AI perform work using models and context belong in Mimris AI Workspace.
- The products are complementary and share the concept of a Universe; they are not two versions of the same application.

## Public demos and source

- Mimris Modelling demo: https://mimris.vercel.app
- Mimris AI Workspace demo: https://mimris-ai-workspace.vercel.app
- Mimris Modelling public source: https://github.com/Mimris/mimris
- Mimris AI Workspace source is not public. Use the public demo and this site for public references.
- Modelling videos by Snorre Fossland: https://www.youtube.com/@SnorresModelBureau

## Primary proof path

The Coffee Shop Universe shows a familiar domain moving from description and explicit model structure into connected work. It links people, products, systems, processes, information, model views, documents, decisions, and work items across both products.

## Primary audiences

- Enterprise, process, and knowledge modellers
- Solution and enterprise architects
- Knowledge engineers and AI architects
- AI application developers and technical founders
- Business analysts, consultants, and digital-transformation specialists
